title: Stream vs Loop
question: When should you use a stream instead of a traditional for loop in Java 8? When should you prefer the loop?

question: What are the advantages of using Optional over a plain null check in Java?
searchIntent: Optional vs null check java interview
why use Optional instead of null java

title: Parallel Stream Trade-offs
question: What are the performance trade-offs of using parallel streams in Java 8?
seoKeywords: when not to use parallel stream java
searchIntent: parallel stream vs sequential performance java
realWorldScenario: Parallel streams on small collections have more overhead from thread coordination than the savings from parallelism.

title: orElse vs orElseGet Performance
question: Why is Optional.orElseGet() more performant than orElse() when the default value is expensive to compute?
searchIntent: orElse orElseGet performance difference java interview
realWorldScenario: orElse(createExpensiveObject()) always creates the object; orElseGet(() -> createExpensiveObject()) only creates it when needed.

title: map() in Stream vs map() in Optional
question: How is map() different when used on a Stream versus an Optional in Java 8?
seoKeywords: Optional map vs Stream map java

realWorldScenario: Both use a Function to transform the value; Optional.map produces a new Optional, Stream.map produces a new Stream.
